prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1241; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle entered on a red signal and struck the driver's side. Police report requested. Liability appears disputed at this stage pending witness statements.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation received and filed. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash following the impact. Medical records authorization sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Vehicle inspected at repair facility. Damage confirmed to rear quarter panel and driver-side door. Photographs uploaded to file. Repair estimate received and under review. Rental coverage confirmed for insured during repair period.

Entry 4: Received treatment records from claimant's physician showing diagnosis of cervical strain with whiplash-type symptoms. Treatment plan includes physical therapy. Records reviewed and noted in file. Counsel requested a demand package once treatment concludes.

Entry 5: Signal timing data obtained from municipal traffic department supports insured's account of the other driver running a red light. Liability position updated to favor insured. Reserve reviewed and adjusted. Supervisor notified and file remains open pending bodily injury demand from counsel.
